summary: Gemini CLI (@google/gemini-cli) is a TypeScript/Node 20 agent. Its entrypoint is packages/cli/dist/index.js, exposed as the `gemini` binary; `-p` runs it headless. It only speaks the Google Gemini API, through @google/genai (packages/core/src/core/contentGenerator.ts); there is no OpenAI or Anthropic backend. The base URL can be changed with GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL, and the key comes from GEMINI_API_KEY. To reach the OpenAI-compatible recording proxy, the overlay also installs LiteLLM in its own self-contained Python 3.12 under /opt/harness. At run time LiteLLM starts on 127.0.0.1:4000 and serves the Gemini-native endpoints (/v1beta/models/{m}:streamGenerateContent). It translates each request into a streaming OpenAI chat-completions call, with tools, to $PROXY_URL/v1 through a wildcard 'openai/*' route. The Gemini CLI itself is built from the repo source with a bundled Node 20 and is not modified. The auth type (gemini-api-key), telemetry off, usage stats off, auto-update off and folder trust off are all set in a system settings file. Tested end to end on buildpack-deps:jammy with a mock OpenAI server: the model's streamed write_file tool call ran, the file was created in the task directory, the tool result was sent back as a role=tool message, and the run exited 0.
dockerfile:
ARG BASE=buildpack-deps:jammy
FROM ${BASE}

ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl git xz-utils ripgrep \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Self-contained Node 20 runtime for gemini-cli
ARG NODE_VERSION=20.19.5
RUN set -eux; arch="$(dpkg --print-architecture)"; \
    case "$arch" in amd64) narch=x64;; arm64) narch=arm64;; *) echo "unsupported arch $arch"; exit 1;; esac; \
    mkdir -p /opt/harness/node /opt/harness/bin; \
    curl -fsSL "https://nodejs.org/dist/v${NODE_VERSION}/node-v${NODE_VERSION}-linux-${narch}.tar.xz" \
      | tar -xJ -C /opt/harness/node --strip-components=1

# Self-contained Python + LiteLLM: translates Gemini API (generateContent) -> OpenAI chat completions at $PROXY_URL
ENV UV_INSTALL_DIR=/opt/harness/uv \
    UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR=/opt/harness/python \
    UV_TOOL_DIR=/opt/harness/uv-tools \
    UV_TOOL_BIN_DIR=/opt/harness/bin \
    UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/uv-cache
RUN curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh \
    && /opt/harness/uv/uv python install 3.12 \
    && /opt/harness/uv/uv tool install --python 3.12 'litellm[proxy]' \
    && rm -rf /tmp/uv-cache \
    && /opt/harness/bin/litellm --help >/dev/null

# Build gemini-cli from source
COPY . /opt/harness/src
RUN set -eux; export PATH=/opt/harness/node/bin:$PATH; cd /opt/harness/src; \
    HUSKY=0 npm ci --ignore-scripts; \
    GIT_COMMIT=unknown HUSKY=0 npm run build; \
    npm cache clean --force

RUN printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' 'exec /opt/harness/node/bin/node /opt/harness/src/packages/cli/dist/index.js "$@"' > /opt/harness/bin/gemini \
    && chmod +x /opt/harness/bin/gemini

RUN printf '%s\n' \
    'model_list:' \
    '  - model_name: "*"' \
    '    litellm_params:' \
    '      model: "openai/*"' \
    '      api_base: os.environ/OPENAI_BASE_URL' \
    '      api_key: os.environ/OPENAI_API_KEY' \
    'litellm_settings:' \
    '  drop_params: true' \
    > /opt/harness/litellm.yaml

RUN printf '%s\n' '{' \
    '  "security": { "auth": { "selectedType": "gemini-api-key" }, "folderTrust": { "enabled": false } },' \
    '  "privacy": { "usageStatisticsEnabled": false },' \
    '  "telemetry": { "enabled": false },' \
    '  "general": { "enableAutoUpdate": false, "enableAutoUpdateNotification": false }' \
    '}' > /opt/harness/gemini-system-settings.json

ENV PATH=/opt/harness/bin:$PATH
run_command: mkdir -p /out/gemini-home; litellm --config /opt/harness/litellm.yaml --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4000 > /out/litellm.log 2>&1 & LPID=$!; for i in $(seq 1 180); do curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:4000/health/liveliness >/dev/null && break; sleep 1; done; gemini -p "$TASK" -m gemini-2.5-pro --yolo --skip-trust -o stream-json 2>&1 | tee /out/gemini-stream.jsonl; rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; kill $LPID 2>/dev/null; exit $rc
notes: Gemini CLI has no OpenAI or Anthropic client, so a local LiteLLM gateway sits in front of it. The gateway accepts Gemini API calls on 127.0.0.1:4000 and forwards them to $PROXY_URL/v1/chat/completions. LiteLLM's wildcard route sends every Gemini model name (the main model and any helper or router models) to the proxy as the same name, e.g. 'gemini-2.5-pro'. The auth type has to be set to gemini-api-key in the system settings file. Without it, setting GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL auto-selects the 'gateway' auth type, and headless auth validation rejects that type. Outputs: the stream-json event log goes to /out/gemini-stream.jsonl, the full session transcript to /out/gemini-home/.gemini/tmp/<project>/chats/session-*.jsonl, and the LiteLLM log to /out/litellm.log. The build downloads Node 20.19.5 and uv/Python 3.12. LiteLLM is not pinned to a version (pin it for reproducibility). The base image's python and node are left alone. Token stats in the CLI output show 0 through this path, but that does not affect the run. Verified by building on buildpack-deps:jammy (arm64) and running one task against a mock OpenAI streaming server, with both the tool call and the final answer, exit code 0.
